plain: For the no trance inner contact, I would do: Pacing (saying plain true things to settle yourself): notice you can see, it's (name the day of the week), you have feet, you can read, you can write, etc. Suggestion: in your mind, ask one clear question and wait, but don't focus too hard. Choice: you can answer the question, write an answer, write that you don't know, take a break, rephrase the question, ask someone else, stop doing this, etc. Autonomous (let the answer come on its own): write whatever you get. Deepener (a step that takes you further into trance): none. Handoff: have your adult self answer the question in whatever way is appropriate, preferably by writing or doing. Integration/exit: reality test what you wrote (check it against ordinary facts), do one small thing based on it, stop doing it.
heading: 9. No-trance inner contact
